_doc: RI-024 fixture. /responses tools support a 'strict' mode (default false) that forces the model to produce JSON conforming exactly to the declared schema. Anthropic /v1/messages has no equivalent strict toggle on its tool defs; XLI's translate_inbound_tools passes input_schema → parameters verbatim and does NOT inject strict=true. The DEGRADES gap: downstream /responses tools default to non-strict, weakening the JSON contract on tool-call arguments. This fixture locks the current non-strict pass-through behavior + documents the closure target (strict=true injection or a schema-derived heuristic).

_known_gap.description: Anthropic tool defs have no strict flag; XLI's translate_inbound_tools does not inject strict=true on the Responses-shape projection. Tool-call arguments accordingly accept non-conformant JSON from the model. Closure options: inject strict=true unconditionally, or split tool defs into strict/non-strict buckets based on schema completeness (required/properties shape).
